security_spec.violation_condition: In the FreeBSD kernel, when S-mode (supervisor) reprograms SPMP entries via siselect/sireg/sireg2 during dynamic context switch and returns to the incoming user process without executing SFENCE.VMA (rs1=x0, rs2=x0) between the last CSR write and the first user-mode instruction, the SPMP hardware does not guarantee that the new entries are architecturally visible. The incoming process's memory accesses may be checked against stale SPMP rules from the outgoing process, or the SPMP may see a partially updated configuration.
security_spec.summary: SPMP indirect CSR writes via siselect are not ordered with respect to subsequent memory accesses; FreeBSD must issue SFENCE.VMA (rs1=x0, rs2=x0) after SPMP reprogramming during context switch or risk cross-process memory access via stale SPMP rules
